challenge.name: Mad Libs
challenge.description: Fill in the blanks! Our Mad Libs game prints back whatever you type. Binary: https://sunshinectf.games/files/fbf35f/mad_libs

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Format-string vulnerability -> overwrite printf@GOT with system() via %hhn, then feed /bin/sh to get a shell and cat /ctf/flag.txt: sun{f1ll_iN_th3_g0T_eNtry} | Evidence: mad-libs is a PIE, Partial RELRO, NX, Canary binary; main (0x11c9) loops 8 times doing fgets(buf,0x100) then printf(buf), a classic format-string bug (objdump disasm shows `call 10b0` = printf with user buffer as format). ; Positional leak probing identified: arg43 = libc_base+0x2a1ca (return addr into libc) and arg47 = PIE_base+0x11c9 (code pointer), both stable across env/stack layouts (verified locally with patchelf'd binary using the supplied ldM/libcM and against the remote service). ; Provided libcM-so.6 is GLIBC 2.39; system offset 0x58740, printf@GOT = PIE_base+0x4010 (readelf -r: printf reloc at 0x4010; PLT .plt.sec 0x10b0 -> jmp [rip+0x2f56] = 0x4010). ; Built a 6x %hhn format string writing the 48-bit system() address over printf@GOT (addresses stored after the specifiers so NUL bytes don't truncate the format). After the write, the next printf('(%d) > ') resolves to system() and the following printf(user_input) becomes system(user_input). ; Sent /bin/sh at the appropriate iteration, obtained a root shell, and `cat /ctf/flag.txt` returned: sun{f1ll_iN_th3_g0T_eNtry} (also present at ./flag.txt in /ctf).
solution_steps: 反汇编 mad-libs 的 main (0x11c9)：循环 8 次 fgets(buf,0x100) 后 printf(buf)，存在格式化字符串漏洞；GOT 可写（Partial RELRO），libc/ld 由附件提供（glibc 2.39）。
用 patchelf 把解释器指向提供的 ld，libc.so.6 指向 libcM-so.6，复现远程布局；用 %N$p 定位，发现 arg43=libc+0x2a1ca、arg47=PIE+0x11c9（均可稳定用于泄漏，AT_PHDR 位置随环境变化不可靠）。
第一轮发送 "%43$p|%47$p"，得到 libc_base 与 PIE_base；system=libc_base+0x58740，printf@GOT=PIE_base+0x4010。
第二轮构造格式化字符串，把 printf@GOT 的 6 个字节用 %hhn 按字节升序写入（地址放在格式串之后并对齐到 8 字节边界，参数下标=8+偏移/8），从而把 printf@GOT 改成 system。
第三轮：GOT 已被改写，循环开头的 printf("(%d) > ") 变成 system("(%d) > ")，随后 printf(buf) 变成 system(buf)。发送 /bin/sh 获得 shell。
在 shell 中 cat /ctf/flag.txt 得到 sun{f1ll_iN_th3_g0T_eNtry}。
evidence: mad-libs is a PIE, Partial RELRO, NX, Canary binary; main (0x11c9) loops 8 times doing fgets(buf,0x100) then printf(buf), a classic format-string bug (objdump disasm shows `call 10b0` = printf with user buffer as format).

Positional leak probing identified: arg43 = libc_base+0x2a1ca (return addr into libc) and arg47 = PIE_base+0x11c9 (code pointer), both stable across env/stack layouts (verified locally with patchelf'd binary using the supplied ldM/libcM and against the remote service).
Provided libcM-so.6 is GLIBC 2.39; system offset 0x58740, printf@GOT = PIE_base+0x4010 (readelf -r: printf reloc at 0x4010; PLT .plt.sec 0x10b0 -> jmp [rip+0x2f56] = 0x4010).

Built a 6x %hhn format string writing the 48-bit system() address over printf@GOT (addresses stored after the specifiers so NUL bytes don't truncate the format). After the write, the next printf('(%d) > ') resolves to system() and the following printf(user_input) becomes system(user_input).
Sent /bin/sh at the appropriate iteration, obtained a root shell, and `cat /ctf/flag.txt` returned: sun{f1ll_iN_th3_g0T_eNtry} (also present at ./flag.txt in /ctf).
Platform confirmed the submission as CORRECT.

replay.reason: 提供的 EXP 运行命令不符合安全的单脚本格式，需人工复现。
